name: @jdf/demo-rag-benchmark
description: Video presentation of the JDF-vs-PDF RAG benchmark (Remotion). Every number on screen comes from docs/bench.json, i.e. from bench/results/*.json.

scripts.render: tsx scripts/make-score.ts && remotion render src/index.ts RagBenchmark out/rag-benchmark.mp4 --crf 16 && cp out/rag-benchmark.mp4 rag-benchmark.mp4
scripts.stills: for f in 60 240 420 660 900 1080; do remotion still src/index.ts RagBenchmark out/still-$f.png --frame=$f; done
